title: CUSTOM_AGENT_CAPABILITY_IDS list is incomplete — 8 of 13 listed
reality: packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts defines 13 capability IDs: create_lorebooks, edit_lorebooks, edit_messages, edit_trackers, change_frontend_styling, change_backgrounds, change_sprites, control_media, control_haptics, edit_about_me, trigger_image_generation, access_vectors, edit_main_prompt. references/agents.md line 220 lists only 8, omitting change_backgrounds, change_sprites, control_media, control_haptics, and edit_about_me.
fix: Replace the inline list in the 'Custom agent capabilities' section of references/agents.md with all 13 IDs in source order. The five missing ones are exactly the media/scene capabilities most relevant to ideation advice (backgrounds, sprites, music, haptics, About Me), so the omission actively misleads.

title: Agent Budget settings (contextSize / maxTokens) undocumented
reality: Custom agents expose an Agent Budget: settings.contextSize (DEFAULT_AGENT_CONTEXT_SIZE = 5 — how many recent messages the agent reads) and settings.maxTokens (DEFAULT_AGENT_MAX_TOKENS = 4096, MIN 128, MAX 32768 — output room reserved). Confirmed in packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts:521-524 and consumed via normalizeAgentContextSize in agent-executor.ts. references/agents.md mentions contextSize only in passing and never gives the defaults or the max-token range.
fix: Add an 'Agent Budget' subsection to the Custom Agents section of references/agents.md with both settings, their defaults, and the 128-32768 range. Tie it to the new contextSources note: when chatHistory is disabled, agentContextSize is forced to 0, so the two controls interact.

title: settings.triggerLorebooksForAgentCalls undocumented
reality: agent-executor.ts (lines 1565, 1615, 1689) and generate.routes.ts (line 3292) gate lorebook activation for agent calls on settings.triggerLorebooksForAgentCalls === true, applied to non-built-in (custom) agents. It is a real per-agent opt-in that changes what lore an agent sees and what it costs.
fix: Document in references/agents.md alongside the new Context Sources table. Note the distinction: activatedLorebookEntries (contextSources) passes entries that already fired this turn, while triggerLorebooksForAgentCalls causes the agent call itself to trigger lorebook scanning. Users conflate these; naming both prevents a wrong diagnosis when lore reaches an agent unexpectedly.

title: Music DJ folder settings not named
reality: agent-executor.ts references settings.customMusicFolder, settings.customMusicExternalFolder, settings.localMusicFolder, and settings.localMusicExternalFolder — the configuration surface behind the Music DJ agent's Game Assets / local music provider mode that references/agents.md describes only narratively.
fix: Add the four setting keys to the `spotify` (Music DJ) bullet in references/agents.md so local-music configuration questions can be answered concretely rather than by pointing at the UI.

title: BUILT_IN_AGENTS empty-array runtime-population still accurate — no drift
reality: packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts:519 still declares `export const BUILT_IN_AGENTS: BuiltInAgentMeta[] = []`, populated at runtime from installed package manifests, matching the claim already in references/agents.md line 7. Verified unchanged at v2.4.0.
fix: No change needed. Recorded to prevent a future pass from re-flagging this as suspicious.
